title: CAMP Signaling Pathway in bPACy and WT Organisms
summary: This cluster focuses on the signaling pathway of cAMP in bPACy and wild-type (WT) organisms. The bPACy organism has lower abundance of Pde1 and adenylate energy charge, and is exposed to darkness. WT organisms are exposed to darkness, harvested in 0.9% NaCl, and have plasmids. The cAMP method regulates several genes and proteins, including Cyr1, GCN4, PKA, Pde1, and adenylate cyclase. LFM is incubated in blue light illumination and shifted to darkness, and is inoculated into both bPACy and WT organisms. The proteome and ribosome are associated with bPACy.
